test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - General Awareness (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Match the following parties with their reserved symbols and choose the INCORRECT one among the following:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**All India Trinamool Congress – Sickle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reserved symbol of the **All India Trinamool Congress (AITC)** is not a sickle but **Flowers and Grass**.
 
• The **symbol** of Flowers and Grass represents the party's commitment to its grassroots approach and policies.
 
• Founded by **Mamata Banerjee** in 1998, the AITC is primarily active in the state of **West Bengal**.
 
• The party has been recognized as a **national party** by the Election Commission of India due to its significant presence in multiple states.
 
• The incorrect association of the sickle symbol could lead to confusion as the sickle is more commonly associated with **leftist or communist ideologies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National People’s Party – Book**__

 __
 
• The **National People’s Party (NPP)** uses the symbol of a **Book**, which signifies education, knowledge, and enlightenment.
 
• The NPP is primarily based in the northeastern state of **Meghalaya**.
 
• Founded by **P.A. Sangma** in 2013, the NPP is the first political party from the Northeast to achieve the status of a **national party**.
 
 
 
• **Bahujan Samaj Party – Elephant**__
 __
 
• The symbol of the **Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP)** is an **Elephant**, representing strength and the oppressed sections of society.
 
• The BSP was founded by **Kanshi Ram** in 1984 and is primarily focused on the welfare of **Scheduled Castes (Dalits), Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes (OBCs).**
 
• The party is headquartered in **New Delhi** and has a strong political presence in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
 
 
• **Nationalist Congress Party – Clock**__
 
 
• The **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)** has the reserved symbol of a **Clock**, symbolizing time and progress.
 
• Founded in 1999 by **Sharad Pawar**, the NCP is headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• The party focuses on promoting **secularism, democracy, and federalism.**
